'''Geffen''' was the first officer onboard the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Unidentified Torpedo Sphere (Tallaan)|Torpedo Sphere]] stationed near [[Tallaan]], in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His commanding officer was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Edric Darius]].
